value.rationale: The natural question is the translation-equivariant refinement of a known clique-homology Betti-number theorem. The new coset-module injection isolates the exact contribution of order-two intercalates over integers and determines all rational isotypic multiplicities. It explains the complete loss of invariant classes in elementary abelian 2-groups, an effect absent from ordinary ranks and the odd-order setting.
